name: Magistrates
overview: The Scriptures present magistrates as divinely appointed rulers entrusted with the responsibility of judging righteously and wisely, as illustrated in the account from 1 Kings 3:16-21, where King Solomon discerned the truth between two women claiming the same child. This narrative underscores the necessity for magistrates to be diligent and impartial in enforcing justice, reflecting their role as ministers of God who must judge not for man but for God.
